facts.value: Finance is a field that deals with the study of money and investments.
It includes the dynamics of assets and liabilities over time under conditions of different degrees of uncertainty and risk.
In the context of business and management, finance deals with the problems of ensuring that the firm can safely and profitably carry out its operational and financial objectives.
Finance ensures that the firm has sufficient cash flow for ongoing and upcoming operational expenses.
Finance concerns itself with servicing both maturing short-term debt repayments and scheduled long-term debt payments.
The long-term objective of finance is maximizing the value of the business while balancing risk and profitability.
Finance includes questions of which businesses and projects to invest in.
Finance includes questions regarding the mix of funding to be used.
Finance includes questions of what to do with 'excess' capital.
